query: SELECT COALESCE(jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('id',id,'slug',public_slug,'title',title,'investigationState',investigation_state::text,'publicationState',publication_state::text,'priority',priority,'leadInvestigatorId',lead_investigator_id,'version',version,'updatedAt',updated_at) ORDER BY updated_at DESC),'[]'::jsonb) FROM editorial.cases
